checks.finding: design.md Architecture and Components define the loop registry, shared driver, existing suites, baseline tooling, and their interactions; its Data Plan and API / Contract Plan, together with frontend-spec.md and infra-spec.md, identify the JSON/JSON-Schema and Bash/PowerShell implementation choices and explicitly establish that there is no UI or runtime service layer.
SKIP: no explicit component dependency declarations found; checked the Architecture and Components narratives for circular dependency patterns and found none.

design.md:251 uniquely assigns PROJECT_CONTEXT_INVALID to producer skip-stop-message:stop and explicitly forbids quality-gate-outcome, consistent with requirements.md:463-469, but design.md:1127 describes it as a dedicated skip-stop-message/quality-gate-outcome-kind event. This contradictory schema mapping leaves the persisted event kind and producer contract ambiguous for AC-019 through AC-021.

design.md API / Contract Plan enumerates the changed shell/PowerShell function contracts, CLI flags, event-trace schema and event types, inputs, outputs, exit behavior, compatibility guarantees, and explicitly records the absence of HTTP endpoints and external integrations.

Primary TYPE-D review applies because design.md contains Security Boundaries. It defines B1-B3 with validation and authorization behavior, states the local filesystem/git trust model and absence of authentication and PII, and maps integrity, access-control, injection, and related OWASP concerns; security-spec.md expands these controls through B1-B5. The TYPE-H fallback is therefore inapplicable.
SKIP: Feature Type is test-infrastructure specification (Phase 1 — no code); frontend-spec.md confirms that the feature has no frontend/backend interaction surface.

The Test Strategy supplies integration, static/schema, acceptance, command, suite, and artifact plans but does not define unit-test scope or what is mocked. It also has no implementable passing path for AC-026: acceptance-tests.md:30 leaves TEST-026 Planned while stating that its producer firing condition is known-unsatisfied by the implementation AC-009 pins; requirements.md:511-532 and OQ-004 at lines 919-952 explain that failing comparisons emit a transition and early returns emit none, while design.md:1141-1150 incorrectly says all open questions are resolved. The design therefore cannot yield passing verification evidence for this acceptance criterion without a further formal amendment.

Every named component in Architecture and API / Contract Plan is defined in design.md Components or established by investigation.md, including the loop inventory, shared driver, consistency/escalation suites, run-record emitter, fixture builder, baseline scripts, allowlist evaluator, trace collector, and structural corpus.

design.md relies on existing ADR-0010, ADR-0016, and ADR-0023 rather than introducing an uncovered architectural departure; investigation.md INV-008 through INV-010 identifies their canonical docs/adr paths and the decisions applied by this design.
